name: Interiors & More Ltd.
summary: Interiors & More Ltd. is a design-centric company that manufactures, trades, and exports artificial décor solutions for residential, commercial, and event-based styling needs. Their product portfolio includes artificial flowers, plants, greenery, vases, planters, candleware, decorative lights, chandeliers, fragrances, and banquet furniture. The company serves a diverse clientele including event planners, interior designers, hospitality firms, and direct consumers, with offerings utilized in weddings, high-profile events, luxury venues, homes, and office spaces. Headquartered in Mumbai, India, with a manufacturing unit in Gujarat and an international showroom in Dubai, Interiors & More Ltd. operates within the artificial décor industry, catering to both Indian and international markets.
